failure_analysis: No failed hidden cases across the three trials. The rendered docs supported this task well: the Tag Processor overview explicitly says to use WP_HTML_Tag_Processor for flat source-order reads and changes to attributes/classes, while reserving WP_HTML_Processor for structural work. The Usage section gives the exact create/scan/mutate/read workflow. The get_attribute_names_with_prefix() section states names are returned lowercase and matching is case-insensitive, which prevented failures on DATA-TRACK-ID. The next_tag() section says tag-like text inside comments is not matched and incomplete trailing tags are not modified. The get_updated_html() section clearly says this is the correct way to retrieve queued attribute edits while preserving untouched bytes. Near-misses: remove_attribute() works for case-insensitive names and duplicate attributes, but its method-level documentation is much thinner than surrounding prose; get_attribute_names_with_prefix() implies but does not explicitly demonstrate that a matched tag with no matching attributes returns an empty array rather than null.

doc_gaps.problem: The return contract distinguishes null for no matched tag, but does not explicitly call out the empty-array case for a matched tag with no attributes using the requested prefix.
doc_gaps.suggestion: Add a sentence and small method-level example: when currently matched on a tag opener and no attribute names match the prefix, the method returns array(), while null means there is no current tag opener.

doc_gaps.problem: The method-level documentation only says it removes an attribute and returns whether one was removed. It omits details that are important when composing it with get_attribute_names_with_prefix(): attribute-name matching is ASCII case-insensitive, absent attributes are safe no-ops, and duplicate case-variant attributes are removed together.
doc_gaps.suggestion: Expand the docblock to state the name comparison rules, no-op behavior when no opener or no such attribute is matched, and duplicate-attribute handling; include the precise meaning of the boolean return.
